detail.name: Senior Software Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Overview

🚀 Exciting Opportunity at Microsoft Surface Windows Display team! 🚀

Are you passionate about developing cutting-edge display technologies? 🛠️ We're on the lookout for a talented Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. If you love working on OEM products, leading third-party teams, and designing and developing display drivers, then this role is perfect for you! 🎯👩‍💻👨‍💻

Here, your efforts are not just part of the process; they are at the forefront of delivering high-quality display solutions to our customers. Join us in shaping the future of technology and making a difference in the world. 🌍

Ready to take on this exciting challenge? Apply now and be part of an innovative team driving excellence in Display world! 🏆✨

Are you passionate about building cool devices and technologies? The Surface Team focuses on building devices that fully express the Windows vision. A fundamental part of our strategy is having desirable and powerful devices that enable the experiences people want and elicit their excitement. Creating these devices involves a close partnership between hardware and software engineers, designers, and manufacturing. We are currently building the next generation and Surface needs you!



Responsibilities
  • Lead the design and architecture of complex software systems, engineering roadmaps, making key decisions that affect the project's direction.
  • Deliver high quality results with full ownership.
  • Create a strong culture of engineering excellence, customer passion, collaboration, diversity and inclusion.
  • Hire and develop the best talent.
  • Must be self-driven, curious to learn, proactive and result oriented.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer/Software Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: At least 8 years of experience in embedded domain working on drivers and firmware.
  • Development Skills: Proficiency in C/C++ and driver development.
  • Problem Solving: Strong debugging skills for modern multiprocessor systems, including using hardware-level code debuggers and diagnostic tools. Familiarity with debugging tools like windbg is a plus.
  • Communication: Effective verbal and written communication, from block diagrams to low-level C code explanations.
  • Adaptability: Ability to plan work and adjust as needed in a dynamic global environment.
  • Technical Acumen: Capability to understand and integrate technical concepts across various disciplines.
  • Enthusiasm: Motivated and self-driven attitude.
  • Travel: Some travel may be required.
  • Deep background and understanding in Windows and PC architecture, including driver architecture.
  • Windows driver development framework(WDF/KMDF/UMDF) knowledge.
  • Working knowledge of display technologies like DP, HDR, OLED.
  • Working knowledge of HW like GPU, TCON.
  • Experience in display color calibration.
  • Enthusiastic, motivated and self-driven.
  • High tolerance to ambiguity and ability make progress in the face of it.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer.
